notes: s013/s014: the ASV writes three English words, so rule 94 forbids one compound unit; the whole correlative goes to ὅσον and ἐπί is left unrepresented under rule 34's pleonastic arm. Splitting the first *as* onto ἐπί remains defensible.
s024 keeps *away* inside the verb because the expressed ἀπό has its own *from*, which rule 106's addition arm requires.
